verdict.rationale: Stripe ships CLI tooling (Stripe CLI sandbox creation with no account registration, Link CLI, mppx validate conformance CLI) and API-key/MCP mechanisms (RAKs, MCP server) that are usable non-interactively/programmatically, supporting CI-style automation of Stripe integrations and payments. However, the MCP server documents a mandatory human-approval gate for write actions (refunds, outbound payments) that blocks full headless automation for those flows, and there is no explicit CI pipeline documentation or independent confirmation of running the whole agentic-commerce stack unattended. Missing for 10: explicit CI/pipeline documentation or examples, confirmation that write-action approval gates can be bypassed or automated in CI, and independent/hands-on verification of headless operation.
